title: Syntax highlighter ships shell grammars that list curl, wget and bash as keywords
intent: Observed in prismjs (components/prism-bash.js), storybook's bundled syntax highlighter and nx's graph client: a bash grammar's builtin regex is an alternation `(?:…|bash|…|curl|cut|…|wget|…|zsh)`, and highlight.js keyword tables are space-separated (`cp cpp curl cvpa`). Neither downloads anything, so the download-and-execute pattern must not read `curl|…|zsh` as a pipeline and the shell-tool pattern needs an operand.
